author: TeIq
content: Origin: proto-blue reuse audit during #51. Two functions perform identical ProtoLabel → serde_json::Value → lex_json::LexValue → lex_cbor bytes transformation: polaris-backend/src/labeler/emitter.rs:542 (encode_canonical) and polaris-backend/src/ingest/upstream_labels.rs:727 (encode_label_canonical). Both are on the signature-canonicality path; if one drifts, signed labels could fail to verify against externally-signed labels. Fix: extract to polaris-backend/src/labeler/canonicalize.rs as the single source of truth; both consumers import. No public API change.
